item.title: Automatically adding Kubernetes Service DNS records to Microsoft DNS using CoreDNS and k8s_gateway
item.description: When I deploy a new service into a namespace, I need to create a new DNS record that makes it available. I’ve previously talked about using CoreDNS to host my lab DNS zones, but this is something different. I want to make a Kubernetes Service available using an existing Microsoft DNS server - which is already used by all the clients who would need to access the service.
